name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 24 - Am 31
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 24a. Urges the relevant Member States to ensure full and timely redress for all homeowners, community groups and small businesses affected by defective concrete products, by introducing a compensation scheme that covers 100 % of the real costs of remediation or rebuilding, including the cost of temporary relocation for residents and storage of furniture and belongings; emphasises that this redress must include all impacted jurisdictions, ensuring cross-border consistency;
